shortDescription.default: Weekly Pulse Quiz: one multiple-choice question a week on a SharePoint page and in Microsoft 365 Copilot.

longDescription.default: Weekly Pulse Quiz shows one multiple-choice question per ISO week from a SharePoint list, saves each answer to a Responses list with item-level security so colleagues can't see it, and gives simple, professional feedback: a check mark for right answers, the correct answer for wrong ones, and an optional justification. Works as a SharePoint web part and as a Microsoft 365 Copilot UX component. No API permissions are requested.

features.title: Weekly Pulse Quiz
features.description: Weekly Pulse Quiz web part and Copilot component.
